task: Extend the webhook receiver so it can accept deployment callbacks alongside build notifications. Current senders put the environment in "environment"; older workers send the same value as "target". Record the environment, the service, the git revision, and the attempt number, using 1 when the sender leaves the attempt out. Treat the partner states "error" and "failed" as failure. A sample callback captured from the staging bus is included in the new tests and should be stored as a successful production deploy of billing at revision 9f3c1a2b; keep signature checks and replay protection as they are, and cover the legacy target form plus a replayed deployment id.
